subject: What to Pack for GF Travel in Japan

media.alt_text: Graphic packing list card for gluten-free travel in Japan

caption.body:
What I packed for Japan as a celiac: a celiac dining card in Japanese saved on my phone (useful since English isn't guaranteed in every kitchen), GF tamari packets (6-8 small single-serve ones lasted the full trip), GF snack bars for bullet trains and long temple days, and a translation app with camera mode for reading ingredient labels in konbini.

I only ended up pulling the card out once, at a ryokan dinner — but having it meant one less thing to worry about.
